verdict: revise

Reviewed main `dacb5fba604f3686d85f548a787b3a6aa9f5912f`. The corrected request below preserves design limits and leaves substantive preparation requirements open.

## Standards
The original draft has sentences above 25 words (#400 decoded body:69,72); the corrected draft uses shorter sentences.
No repository file changed. Startup diagnostics reported `ok`.

## Spec
All 19 map rows cite indexed evidence and use the correct milestone labels; [the row-by-row assessment](artifacts/review-evidence.md) records their scope.
Revise row 7 (#400 body:40): native execution is blocked, but public typedef-impact and diagram-difference specifications are `not-met-now-doable` (benchmark/protocol.md:127).
Rows 6 and 8 remain defensible only for existing specifications and native designs; they do not complete those missing designs (benchmark/protocol.md:15,18,55).
Row 14 (#400 body:47) omits provider/model quota, the repetition/precision plan and independent executable scorer review (benchmark/protocol.md:90).
Add explicit edit/build authorization and pinned semantic-documentation obligations (benchmark/protocol.md:55,59,120); current native operations exclude edits and builds.
The script confirmed the index hash below, identical benchmark/docs trees across the old baseline and main, and delivery figures at docs/research/0002-delivery.md:123,153.
The status supports scoped family limitations, including Anthropic review #347 and cross-family fix review #369; it does not establish draft-review claims about #391/#397.
Verification passed: `python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`; 65 references, no errors or missing files, execution/readiness false, quality null.
Full evidence, source lines, omitted obligations and smallest closing tasks: [review evidence](artifacts/review-evidence.md).

## Corrected owner request draft

**title:** Assess the verification method and its documented design limits

**what:** Please assess the verification method and its preparation evidence. Accept the documented design scope, or identify the changes you require.
Use main commit `dacb5fba604f3686d85f548a787b3a6aa9f5912f`.
Use preparation index SHA256 `ccff5e0e77e4010a0101757c03f66f08a6cd72af83baba7791204a020f345e8f`.
Read `benchmark/protocol.md` at that commit and the evidence files identified by the index.
The commit identifies the protocol because the index does not include it.
Exclude the unindexed native job draft from the pinned acceptance evidence.

**why:** The method defines separate checks for reading fidelity, answer correctness and source grounding.
Existing reviews cover public XML keys, design contracts and synthetic scoring tests.
The preparation status records their limits.
Missing evidence remains a requirement before implementation acceptance.
This decision establishes no benchmark readiness, quality threshold, goal gate or product claim.
It selects no fallback and reduces no goal scope.

**unblocks:** Your decision can settle acceptance of the documented design scope through the existing owner gate.
Complete the remaining preparation and evidence requirements before implementation acceptance.
Each work change still requires the applicable owner decision.

1. Check the commit and index hash above. Read the protocol, requirement-map review and limitations in `benchmark/preparation-status.json`. Keep the protocol's substantive evidence requirements open.
2. Retain every execution gap. Native executions remain zero. All 23 native slots remain unresolved. No split allocation exists. Store readiness evidence remains pending #379 under capability #268. The owner confirmed #268 readiness, but the indexed status still lacks usable checked readiness evidence. Native capability #169 remains not ready. No native key, native challenge result or matched model comparison exists.
3. Retain both missing development case designs: typedef-impact and diagram-difference. Commission one public specification for each design and obtain a separate review. Freeze questions, required claim identifiers, original identities, edit procedures, observation procedures and checker steps. Mark unavailable native answers explicitly. Separate diagram edits that change behavior from edits that change presentation. Obtain an explicit edit or build grant before those operations.
4. Retain the remaining oracle and comparison requirements. Pin semantic documentation by version, location and content hash. Resolve disputed expected claims before key use. Verify provider/model quota, independent scorer review and the development precision plan before comparison. Native and store capabilities alone do not complete these requirements.
5. Assess the recorded review limitations. GPT-family authors and reviewers performed split, baseline-template, native-design and synthetic-scorer reviews. The scorer retains `independently_reviewed: false`. Raw-record review also carries a GPT-family limit. Review #347 used the same Anthropic family as its author. Review #369 checked the reason-control fix across model families. These reviews establish their recorded scopes only.
6. Read `docs/research/0002-delivery.md:105–109,123,143,153–163`. That report estimates 89–264 engineer-days for all versions and 33–99 for the 2024-only core. Subtracting corresponding endpoints gives 56–165 engineer-days. These figures are uncertain planning estimates. That report's strict 2024 option excludes 413 of its 415 versioned RSRC files. The authoritative save-version field and broader compatibility remain uncertain. This information selects no fallback.
7. Record an explicit decision through the existing owner change gate. Identify the commit, index hash, accepted design scope and remaining requirements. Accept that documented scope, or reject it and state the required changes. Keep substantive evidence obligations open before implementation acceptance. Approve no benchmark readiness, quality threshold, goal gate, product claim or fallback through this decision.

## What next
The Policymaker can use the corrected draft above and commission the two missing public specifications before requesting unqualified method acceptance.
Resume from the saved row-by-row evidence; do not repeat source extraction, stopped within-repository lineage adjudication, or the successful evaluator check without a relevant change.
Keep native execution dependent on #169 and checked store evidence dependent on #379 under #268. Reassess the commit and index hash if the evidence snapshot changes.
